rationale: Followed the brief's scene in the white/off-white/grey palette; light set to upper-left to match the real pack shots. Props, tints and textures kept in outer or lower areas so the copy and photo zones stay empty. Situation briefs evoke the moment without people or product.

variants.axis_value: Sage and cream panels with faint damp-glass texture
variants.image_prompt: Create a photographic background image: a straight-on view of a backdrop of soft sage #D8DDD0 and cream #EFEBE0 flat panels meeting at a vertical edge at the far right, with a faint damp-glass texture only along the bottom edge. Lighting: gentle light from the upper left at 5600K, soft shadows falling to the lower right. Background: matte panels, low saturation. Style: spec sheet geometry, restrained. The left half of the frame is intentionally empty, an even low-detail field for headline copy added later. The right 45% of the frame is intentionally empty, an evenly lit open area reserved for a photo placed later. The bottom quarter of the frame stays plain and calm. Square 1:1, 1024x1024, 50mm lens at f/8 so the whole surface is sharp, fine photographic detail, no film grain. Do not include: any text, letters, numbers, logos, product, bottle, tube, packaging, people, faces, skin, hands.
variants.negative_prompt: Do not include: any text, letters, numbers, logos, product, bottle, tube, packaging, people, faces, skin, hands.

asset_requirements: real pack shot composited by the tool
